gaps: Pre-2004 NAIA seasons: no poll archives found (wayback NAIA release archives start 2005-06; athletics.biola.edu stories start 2006). Only a 2002 men's 'RV' tag from a 2022 retrospective.

2004: only preseason and final-regular-season women's ranks and two men's weekly ranks taken from Biola EagleSports Weekly PDFs (Drive); the other 2004 weekly issues (9-13 to 11-22) were not read; men's column mapping inferred from layout.

2005, 2007, 2008 (both sports) and 2010-2012 women: no Biola story or archived NAIA poll showing Biola ranked or receiving votes; archived NAIA releases for 2005-2010 are sparse (mostly non-poll pages), so absence is unconfirmed.
2006-2010 NAIA weekly polls are known only through Biola stories (no primary poll pages archived); weeks are approximate.

NAIA weekly polls not archived/fetched: men 2011 Sept. 13 (archived page shows the next week's table), 2014 polls after preseason were archived and show no Biola; women 2013 Oct. 8 and 2016 final regular-season poll (~Nov. 13) missing; some NAIA 2011-2016 release pages failed to download from the Wayback Machine.
Women's 2014: Biola story (11/7/2014) says the team climbed to No. 8, but every archived 2014 NAIA poll peaks at No. 9 (Oct. 14). Unresolved.
2017-2018: NCAA DII provisional years, not eligible for NCAA regional/national rankings. Only an NCCAA No. 2 (women, Nov. 2017) was found; NCCAA poll archives not checked.

United Soccer Coaches DII West regional polls: men 2021 polls after Oct. 19, men 2022 polls after Oct. 18, women 2022 polls after Oct. 4, and 2020-21 spring polls were not archived; 2023-2025 women and 2023-2024 men snapshots show no Biola.

NCAA official regional rankings: men 2022 in-season rankings show no Biola (Biola appears only in the final Super Region 4 selection list, per Biola story); 2025 (both sports) ncaa.com snapshots could not be fetched.

United Soccer Coaches DII national polls: men 2019, 2021 and 2022 plus women 2021 snapshots show no Biola; women 2019 only one mid-season snapshot (RV through Nov. 3). Other seasons were not checked for RV.
PacWest preseason poll: women 2022 and 2025 not found in Biola stories; GSAC preseason polls (NAIA era) not collected.
